sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions prohibit pre-payment charges for existing floating-rate term loans sanctioned before 31 December 2025 for purposes other than business to an individual borrower, but that rule does not match a loan sanctioned on 31 December 2025.

The in-force UCB directions also prohibit pre-payment charges on all floating-rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals when sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, but that rule also does not match a 31 December 2025 sanction date.

On the evidence provided, no cited in-force rule directly covers a floating-rate home loan to an individual sanctioned on 31 December 2025, so the evidence does not support a firm yes-or-no answer on levy for this case.

missing.searched: Checked the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 provisions on pre-payment charges for loans sanctioned before 31 December 2025 and on or after 1 January 2026.
